The flagellar motor

A rotary machine spanning the cell envelope. The rotor turns the shaft and external filament while its supports stay anchored.

ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL · MOTION SLOWED
About this model

A visual interpretation of a bacterial cutaway. Molecular shapes use transformed surface atoms from representative PDB structures; these are shape references, not an inventory of bacterial proteins. Motor geometry, scale, pathways, and speed are schematic. Each labeled structure in the Field guide lists its own sources.

Shape data: RCSB PDB 1LYZ, 1UBQ, 1ATP, 1GZX.
